name: Rody
text: Repair log 903: door closer on the east entrance adjusted, latch greased, test swing passed, parts used one pin, completed by Rody

name: Dilekçi
text: Fault reference 5521: the west gate intercom crackles when it rains, handset swapped for a spare and the old one sent to the workshop, outdoor unit resealed, follow up call booked for tuesday, works order closed by Dilekçi

name: Djordjina Maria-Catena
text: Complaint 7742: late night noise from the loading bay, duty manager walked the site twice and found the compressor left running, contractor reminded about shut down times and a timer switch ordered, patrols added for two weeks, the complainant kept updated by phone, case reviewed and closed by Djordjina Maria-Catena

name: Fumio Zereit
text: Sample log 118: river sample collected upstream of the weir, bottles labelled and chilled, chain form filled, results due friday, collected by Fumio Zereit

name: Modaser
text: Equipment log 63: defibrillator pads replaced and battery date checked, cabinet seal wiped, monthly sticker applied, the unit is back on the wall bracket, next check the 1st, verified by Modaser

name: Blloku
text: Waste transfer 21-9: skips swapped on the north pad, two loads tagged as general and one as timber, transfer notes raised for each, the weighbridge tickets stapled to the file, site swept around the pad before the lorries left, duty of care checks passed, paperwork countersigned by Blloku

name: Jashvin Python
text: Acoustic check 14: plant room reading 78 at the door, within the limit, no action needed, signed sheet pinned in the office, measured by Jashvin Python

name: Farah Makhmudov
text: Pest control visit 7: bait stations checked in kitchen, store and bin yard, one station replaced and fresh gel applied, nothing caught in any of them, report emailed to the compliance folder, next visit in eight weeks, carried out by Farah Makhmudov

name: Volkan
text: Roof survey 441: tiles checked across the south pitch, three slipped tiles reset and a cracked one replaced, valley cleared of debris, gutter brackets sound, loft space dry with no staining on the rafters, chimney flashing resealed as a precaution, photos uploaded to the job file, report written by Volkan

name: Jones
text: Parcel audit 36: forty parcels scanned, two labels reprinted, one held for address check, shelf tidied and the trolley returned, checked by Jones

name: Riho Sabariego Ovaiolo
text: Water hygiene 88: tank inspection with lid and vents checked, no debris inside, temperature at the tap reached 52, sentinel outlets flushed for three minutes each, sample sent for legionella testing, all outlets labelled with the asset number, inspection carried out by Riho Sabariego Ovaiolo

name: Redjai Besijan
text: Door entry 302: maglock on the side entrance replaced after water got into the housing, push to exit button tested and range set, fob reader firmware updated, five fobs re-enrolled at the panel, the old lock kept for the warranty file, no faults on the circuit since, job complete and tested by Redjai Besijan

name: Strach
text: Chimney sweep 59: flue brushed from the roof, soot vacuumed from the hearth, smoke test drew clean, certificate left on the mantel, logged by Strach

name: Hamdija
text: Fixings order, bay 12, m6 bolts 400, washers 600, nuts 400, two boxes of cable clips, delivery thursday before noon, put away on arrival and the bin card updated, order raised by Hamdija

name: Servaux
text: Uniform list, autumn issue, fleece 2, polo 3, trousers 2, safety boots 1 pair size 9, name badges 2, waterproof jacket 1, exchanges allowed within two weeks with tags attached, the sheet goes to the stores on friday morning, issued against the starter checklist and countersigned by Servaux

name: Kimey Jotham
text: Opening checks, cafe, till float 120, milk in date, fridges at 4, sanitiser full, doors unlocked at eight, board updated, run by Kimey Jotham

name: King Mear
text: Table plan, awards night, top table 8 seats, rounds 12, 13 and 14, seating mixed across teams, two spare chairs at the back, place cards printed and checked, dietary notes pinned to the kitchen board, the final version approved by King Mear

name: Ediz
text: Safety round, east block, extinguishers all in date, one pressure gauge low and swapped, emergency lights tested at three units, exit doors opened freely, one door closer adjusted on the spot, fire panel showed no faults, the walk took forty minutes and covered both stairwells and the plant room, findings logged by Ediz

name: Calvo
text: Compost bay, rangers yard, turned and damped, two bags of grass clippings added, temperature 55, cover secured, weekend watering rota full, checked by Calvo

name: Fehmije Paca Schödel
text: IT asset row, laptop 14, battery health 89, keyboard and ports clean, screen replaced under warranty last month, imaged with the standard build, docking station mapped to the owner, collection note emailed, register updated and closed by Fehmije Paca Schödel

name: Suhrab Ronn
text: Deep clean row, west pool, grout scrubbed around both ladders, overflow channels cleared of grit, balance tank lids wiped, storage room mopped and drying, pool back open after the hourly check showed chlorine and ph in range, towels restocked at the desk, staff wore the correct ppe and the job took the full morning, signed by Suhrab Ronn

name: Phuntsok
text: Defect sheet, unit 7, tap washer dripping, shut off valve handle stiff, toilet seat loose, mirror light, parts from the van stock, jobs passed to maintenance and closed by Phuntsok

name: Fisler
text: Kitchen close down list, fryers filtered, hobs degreased, surfaces wiped, mop sink drained, dishwasher left on overnight cycle, bins out at the back, lights and gas off at the isolator, the checklist pinned by the back door was initialled by Fisler

name: Donia Ofner
text: Jobs board review, three overdue tickets chased, two parts arrived and fitted the same morning, one access issue rescheduled with the tenant, the contractor confirmed friday between nine and eleven, notes added under each card so the office can see the status, emergency call outs stayed at zero for the month, the board was cleared and reordered by Donia Ofner

name: Al-Hajar Stoeckel
text: Server room round, temperatures 21 and 22, humidity 45, both ac units running, no alerts overnight, UPS self test passed, floor free of boxes, round completed by Al-Hajar Stoeckel

name: Potkonjak
text: Afternoon tea rota, tables booked for 14 and 16, scones and jam ordered, china cups borrowed from the hall, two servers and one washer up arranged, setup from two, clear away by five, the sheet by the till was signed off by Potkonjak

name: Radica
text:
Visitor pass 2331: contractor escorted to the plant room for the boiler quote, escort stayed throughout, lanyard and pass returned at the desk at 12:20, coffee tab settled, the sign in book was updated on the way out, the door codes were not shared, all clear to invoice the visit.
Signed
Radica

name: Haftner
text:
Room turn 12: sheets changed, bins emptied, tray wiped, kettle descaled, window opened for ten minutes, welcome card replaced.
Signed
Haftner

name: Zinnet Beritsang
text:
Meter exchange 77: old electricity meter removed, new unit fitted and sealed, supply restored after the test run, reading logged in the handover book, customer shown how to read the display, sticker with the emergency number left by the fuse board.
Signed
Zinnet Beritsang

name: Rungnapa Fax
text:
Foster home visit 41: annual review completed with both carers present, bedroom and kitchen checked, smoke alarms tested and one battery swapped, medication cupboard locked, garden gate latch repaired on the spot, school attendance records reviewed and up to date, transport arrangements confirmed for the summer, next review in twelve months.
Signed
Rungnapa Fax

name: Mizuki
text:
Bench test 6: thermostat cycled three times, fan spun freely, element resistance 32, timer held, guard refitted with new screws.
Signed
Mizuki

name: Raica
text:
Flat pack build 210: wardrobe and two bedside units assembled in the upstairs room, wall strap fitted behind the wardrobe, packaging taken away by the van crew, drawers adjusted so they run clean, instructions and spare screws left in the top drawer.
Signed
Raica

name: Brighton Township
text:
Coastal survey 19: transect walked from the harbour wall to the west rocks at low tide, plastic fragments counted and bagged by size, two large items logged for collection, gps marks taken, volunteers briefed on the seal colony before the start, the bag count came to eleven and the next survey is the first sunday in may.
Signed
Brighton Township

name: Noorman Corona
text:
Pool test 88: chlorine 1.2, ph 7.4, both in range, backwash done, filters rinsed, plant room tidy.
Signed
Noorman Corona

name: Elischeva
text:
Lamp audit 43: tube swapped in the back corridor, diffuser cleaned and refitted, two starters replaced from the box, emergency pack tested green, the caretaker asked for the spare fittings to stay on site, labels on the box updated with the date.
Signed
Elischeva

name: Pollán
text:
Weekend security summary 22: both patrol rounds completed on the hour, one fence panel found loose at the north corner and tied off, floodlight on the east side replaced and tested, two unauthorised vehicles asked to move, the depot was quiet otherwise, the gate log matches the pass records and no incidents were raised across the whole shift.
Signed
Pollán

name: Van Laere
text:
Call out 77: alarm activated by a spider on the sensor, panel reset, zones walked, keyholder updated, no charge raised.
Signed
Van Laere

name: Madiamba Gwinner
text:
Borehole dip 15: water level at 3.4 metres, pump started by hand and ran clean, pressure held at the tank, no air locks on the line, the pressure switch was adjusted a quarter turn, readings entered on the sheet by the door.
Signed
Madiamba Gwinner

name: Laurentiu-Constantin
text:
Course list, autumn term, glazing 12 enrolled, joinery 9, plumbing 11, electrical 10, plastering 8, all rooms confirmed and tools checked, two late additions moved to the reserve bench, refreshments arranged for the open evening, the print run of handbooks lands monday, the tutor allocation went up on the board friday.
Signed
Laurentiu-Constantin

name: Olsen
text:
Bike rack, block b, 6 hoops added, bolts torqued, ground anchors set, painted line renewed, camera over the rack repositioned to cover the end bays.
Signed
Olsen

name: Emily-Rose Thompson
text:
Plant order, spring beds, lavender 24, thyme 18, rosemary 12, compost 8 bags, bark 6 bags, delivery friday morning, trolley booked from the yard, two volunteers to plant saturday, watering rota to follow.
Signed
Emily-Rose Thompson

name: van der Meij
text:
Catering order, conference, 48 lunches with two vegetarian and one gluten free, flasks of coffee and tea for the morning, fruit bowls refreshed at eleven, afternoon tray with cake, water jugs for each room, dietary cards printed to match the delegate list, the venue kitchen confirmed the delivery slot at seven thirty.
Signed
van der Meij

name: Cham
text:
Gig list, friday, doors 7, support 7:45, main set 9, curfew 11, two encores allowed, backline shared, sound check at five with the house kit.
Signed
Cham

name: Aksayan
text:
Walk list, sunday ramble, meet at the lychgate 9:30, route via the mill and the old canal, 7 miles, moderate pace, two stiles, dogs on leads, packed lunch at the halfway bench, leader carries the first aid kit and the group register.
Signed
Aksayan

name: Ventsislav Asha
text:
Repair queue, week 17, three mobility scooters in for battery swaps, one wheelchair for a brake adjustment, two walking frames for new ferrules, one hoist sling inspection due, parts ordered for the scooter motors, the workshop diary has slots on tuesday and thursday, collection calls go out once each repair passes.
Signed
Ventsislav Asha

name: Hariesh Diethard
text:
Donation log, harvest appeal, tins 84, pasta 40, rice 30, toiletries box 1, cash tin counted, van booked for the food bank run.
Signed
Hariesh Diethard

name: Kolzok
text:
Fixture list, netball, courts 2 and 3 in use, first centre pass 10:15, bibs collected from the shed, umpires confirmed for both games, score table duty shared by the two clubs, the league fees are settled and the results sheet goes online sunday.
Signed
Kolzok

name: Cognié
text:
Fire risk actions, follow up list, three extinguisher points re-sited and photographed, two fire doors adjusted with new hinges, one escape route cleared of storage and repainted, the assembly point sign replaced, drills booked for both offices in june, the assessor comments were addressed in full and the updated certificate is displayed at the main entrance.
Signed
Cognié

name: Cunatti Cuixart Carotenuto
text:
Lost key log, fob 19, replaced cylinder on the store door, new keys cut 3, register updated, old fob disabled at the panel.
Signed
Cunatti Cuixart Carotenuto

name: Vimpere Vuilloud Bentotage
text:
Toolbox talk log, topic working at height, 14 attended, harness checks demonstrated, three lanyards quarantined and replacements issued, ladder pre-use points covered, sign off sheets filed in the site office, next talk on manual handling set for the 12th.
Signed
Vimpere Vuilloud Bentotage
